verdict.rationale: Muse documents its own app-linking capability: users can connect email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health/fitness data, and finances, and choose what the agent can access. It can also write custom connectors for services that have APIs or CLIs. There is no evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps and connectors, and the linkable set reads as a curated first-party list. Missing for 10: a browsable connector/app directory, evidence of third-party connectors beyond the named handful, documentation of the add/install flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
